Evidence: [plan_drift.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_drift.py:811) sets `ack_cmd = "dontpanic resume {plan_id} --all"` and [plan_drift.py](/Users/bayesian/Documents/GitHub/DontPanic/scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/plan_drift.py:844) emits it for `plan-drift-policy-ack`; a direct check printed `dontpanic resume P --all`. That does not clear the drift ack marker and may clear unrelated gates. Recommendation: emit `dontpanic approve <plan> drift:blocking_policy` for blocking policy drift, and ensure CLI/dashboard use that same action.
